image_description: An underwater scene featuring two scuba divers in the foreground and a third diver in the background. The primary subject is a diver on the right, wearing a black wetsuit, BCD, mask, regulator, and fins, swimming horizontally. To the left is another diver, partially visible, also equipped with scuba gear. The water is clear with visible bubbles rising from the regulators. The seabed is sandy with some coral or rock formations.

The fins and lower legs of the diver on the left merge slightly with the background and each other. The geometry is less distinct than the right diver, showing minor fusion artifacts typical of AI generation in complex overlapping regions.

Some hoses connecting the regulators to the tanks have ambiguous paths or terminate without clear connection points, though this is common in real photos due to occlusion. It is a minor logical ambiguity rather than a severe defect.
